title: HAVE I FOUND MY PEOPLE?
content: I haven’t been to mall world in a while..but the last time I was there, I fell asleep otp with someone I was dating at the time. He told me I was talking in my sleep and tryna get out of somewhere—I literally stopped fw him because I honestly couldn’t explain what I was dreaming and he wouldn’t let it go????? NOW I KNOW THIS IS NORMAL? EVERYBODY HAS THEIR OWN MALL WORLD???????
